notes: Sync uses far fewer server reads. A phone now downloads only the rows that changed since its last sync, which keeps sync working for large books.
A stop saved while the phone was pulling changes from the server now always uploads. Saving a spread warns Saved On This Phone Only if any stop did not queue, with Queue Again.
Route shows Address Missing when a stop has no valid service address, instead of using the customer main address.
The top bar on phones no longer covers the first card when it grows taller.
